recent_calls.summary: The user, Cecelia Brinker, called to inquire about a scheduled appointment. The agent was unable to find any appointment under her information and offered to transfer her to a live representative, which the user accepted. The call was then successfully transferred to a live agent.

The user expressed positive feedback about the efficiency of the service and requested a callback for additional information. The call ended with the user being transferred to a live representative for further assistance.

The agent informed him that she could not provide the contact details but would forward his request to the team for follow-up. Jeff provided his phone number for the team to reach him.

The user requested to opt out of future messages and was given a number to call for that purpose before ending the call.

The user requested to speak with a technician, and the agent promptly transferred the call to the appropriate live agent. The transfer was successful, and the call ended shortly after.

The user requested customer service and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance. The transfer was completed successfully without any issues.

She reported that the AC runs but the temperature inside remains at 83 degrees. She requested an appointment any time after 12 PM on a weekday, preferably in the afternoon, and the agent confirmed the details and will have a representative contact her to confirm the appointment.
